source_line: Source: Deloitte 2026 Holiday Retail Survey (Oct 15, 2026); LendingTree (Dec 2025)
caption:
The average U.S. household plans to spend $1,654 this holiday season — but plenty of people are still paying for last Christmas.

Deloitte's 2026 Holiday Retail Survey puts planned spending at $1,654, up 4% from $1,595 last year. Meanwhile, of the Americans who took on holiday debt last season, 41% are STILL paying it off, that debt averaged $1,223, and 40% of them carry an interest rate of 20% or more (LendingTree, Dec. 2025).

It's your paycheck: a gift financed at 20% APR costs far more than its price tag by the time it's paid off.

My take: the plan matters more than the deal. Decide your number before Black Friday, not in the checkout line.
